title: Stop Saying "Very Hot"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very hot". Try one of these instead:
• Boiling: boiling in this small room
• Scorching: a scorching summer day
• Sweltering: the sweltering heat of the city
• Baking: baking outside today
• Roasting: roasting in this sweater

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.

Find more words on anotherwordfor.net
